Our Story

Nithin and Daya

Every love story is beautiful, but we believe ours was lovingly written by God, long before we knew where the journey would lead.

Our story began with an official arranged marriage proposal meeting — two hearts brought together by families, with little idea of the beautiful story that was about to unfold. What began as a simple introduction soon grew into a cherished friendship, filled with meaningful conversations, laughter, understanding, and a growing fondness for one another. Somewhere along the way, a meeting became a connection, a connection became a friendship, and a friendship blossomed into love.

Through every conversation and every shared moment, we found ourselves drawing closer, discovering not only the joy of being together but also the peace of knowing that God had gently guided our paths toward one another.

Our relationship has been built on faith, prayer, trust, and the belief that the best things in life unfold according to His perfect timing. Looking back, we see His hand in every little detail that brought us to this moment.

As our wedding day draws near, our hearts are filled with gratitude — for the prayers that brought us together, for the families who believed in this union, and most of all, for God’s beautiful plan that brought two lives together.

We can’t wait to walk hand in hand into the beautiful future He has planned for us.
